# The 3 real `:message-type` header values, fetched verbatim from
# https://smithy.io/2.0/aws/amazon-eventstream.html (fetched 2026-09-02):
# "event" (a modeled event, `:event-type` names the union member),
# "exception" (a modeled error, `:exception-type` names the shape), "error"
# (the protocol's own generic/unmodeled error, `:error-code`/`:error-message`
# headers carry the detail). `decode.rs`'s `terminal_failure` matches on
# "exception" and "error"; "event" is the fall-through default handled by
# `decode_event` instead.
event
exception
error
